description: Source code for the Twig ExpressionParser class, which implements expression parsing using precedence climbing algorithm, handling various expression types, operators, and function calls within Twig templates.

classes.name: Twig\ExpressionParser
classes.description: Implements expression parsing for Twig templates using precedence climbing, handling operators, function calls, and various expression types.

methods.name: parseExpression
methods.description: Parses an expression with optional precedence, handling arrow functions, binary operators, and conditional expressions.

methods.name: parsePrimary
methods.description: Parses primary expressions such as literals, variables, function calls, or parenthesized expressions.

methods.name: parseStringExpression
methods.description: Parses string expressions, including concatenations and interpolations.

methods.name: parseSequenceExpression
methods.description: Parses array-like sequence expressions enclosed in brackets.

methods.name: parseMappingExpression
methods.description: Parses mapping (associative array) expressions enclosed in braces.

methods.name: getFunctionNode
methods.description: Retrieves or constructs a node for a function call, handling aliases and callable functions.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpression
methods.description: Parses subscript expressions, including dot and array notation.

methods.name: parseFilterExpression
methods.description: Parses filter expressions chained with '|'.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Parses function or filter arguments, supporting named and positional arguments.

methods.name: parseAssignmentExpression
methods.description: Parses variable assignment expressions.

methods.name: parseMultitargetExpression
methods.description: Parses multiple target expressions separated by commas.

methods.name: parseTestExpression
methods.description: Parses test expressions like 'defined' or custom tests.

methods.name: getTest
methods.description: Retrieves a test object by name, handling multi-word tests and deprecations.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a function object by name, handling deprecations.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves a filter object by name, handling deprecations.

methods.name: checkConstantExpression
methods.description: Checks if a node contains only constant expressions, for future removal.

methods.name: setDeprecationCheck
methods.description: Sets the deprecation check flag, returning previous value.

methods.name: createArguments
methods.description: Creates an ArrayExpression from parsed arguments.

methods.name: parseOnlyArguments
methods.description: Parses arguments for function or filter calls.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpressionDot
methods.description: Parses subscript expressions using dot notation.

methods.name: parseSubscriptExpressionArray
methods.description: Parses subscript expressions using array notation.
